image_description: A large bison stands in a wooded area with sandy soil and sparse trees. The animal is viewed from the side, partially obscured by thin tree trunks and foliage. In the immediate foreground, the green hood and windshield wiper of a vehicle are visible, suggesting the photo was taken from inside a car. The bison has dark brown fur, a prominent shoulder hump, and appears to be grazing or standing still.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible in profile. It appears large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are discernible despite some occlusion by branches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of longer, shaggy hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The resolution and distance make it impossible to clearly distinguish the eye color or detail; it appears as a dark shadow but cannot be verified as a 'dark eye' feature specifically.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the head silhouette is smooth and furry where ears would be, consistent with them being hidden in the thick coat.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The height at the shoulders (withers) is significantly higher than the hips, creating the characteristic sloping back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a very clear, large hump at the shoulders covered in thick, dark, shaggy fur. This is the most defining feature present.
The fur on the rear half of the body appears shorter and smoother compared to the dense mane and hump on the front half.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visible and are proportionally small relative to the massive bulk of the head and body.
The lower legs and feet are obscured by the terrain, shadows, and vegetation. Hooves are not visible.
The tail is visible hanging down behind the hind legs. It appears short relative to the body length and ends in a darker, bushy tuft.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the fur on the mid-section and hindquarters appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper definition of the shoulder hump. It lacks the individual strand detail expected in high-res wildlife photography, though this could also be due to motion blur or compression.

artifact_observations.location: Intersection of bison legs and ground/vegetation
artifact_observations.reasoning: The contact points between the hooves/legs and the ground are somewhat indistinct. The legs seem to merge slightly with the shadows and grass rather than having crisp occlusion boundaries, which is a common subtle AI artifact.
